citation: Garnacho-Castaño MV, et al. J Int Soc Sports Nutr 2018;15:49
protocol: Time trial at ventilatory-threshold intensity (cycle ergometer) 2.5 h after beetroot juice or placebo; HR, VO2 and gas exchange at VT1, VT2 and in total; power at VT1, VT2, VO2max from the incremental test
population: 12 well-trained male triathletes, 21-47 y, VO2max 54.8 +/- 3.1 mL/kg/min
note: Placebo rows; blood lactate is mentioned in the text, see Results.
